exo01/hydro.py.name: How the water pushes back
exo01/hydro.py.description: Computes how water resists each hull as it moves, and stores the answer so a nearby position can reuse it instead of waiting again.

exo01/response.py.name: Movement and rope loads in waves
exo01/response.py.description: Turns a wave height, period and direction into how much each craft moves and how hard every rope and fender is pulled, including sudden snatch loads.
